note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording (and the OT renderings made in its register).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where the author puts his own words inside a quotation — '(attributes)' in John 17, '(believers)' in 1 Corinthians 11:30 — the quotation is split around them so only OWB's words stand inside the marks. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, re-personed prayers and confessions, and the author's own phrases.

Recurring-word calls: Psalm 23:3 is OWB «ሕይወቴን ይመልስልኛል»; the author argues from 'restores my soul', so its first full quotation carries the gloss (ማለትም ነፍሴን) and the author's prose keeps ነፍስ. Matthew 16:19 is OWB «ቁልፎች»; the book's own image, 'the key to the kingdom' (መክፈቻ, the title), stays the author's. Revelation 1:8 as cited ('alpha and omega, the beginning and the end') is quoted from OWB Revelation 21:6, where OWB has both halves; the citation keeps the English's 1:8.
